AppQuotaUsage.description:
The App's usage against each quota (named as the quotas; present whether or not the quota
is set).

call_participants_max.description: Members in a call in one of the App's Spaces now.

channels_per_space_max.description: Channels in the App's fullest Space (archived ones count).

file_bytes_max.description: File bytes in the App's Spaces.

members_per_space_max.description: Members of the App's fullest Space.

messages_per_min.description:
Posts the App's bucket holds back now: `messages_per_min` minus the tokens left (0
without the quota).

AppQuotas.description:
An App's quotas: the body of `POST /mgmt/v1/apps/{app_id}/quotas` and `quotas` in its
answer. Each is optional; absent means no App limit.

call_participants_max.description: Concurrent call participants across the App's Spaces, 0–1e9.

file_bytes_max.description:
File bytes in the App's Spaces (what the Space file quota counts: uploads, attachments,
emoji and Space icons), 0–2^62; checked on each new upload.

members_per_space_max.description: Members in each App Space (the owner included), 0–1e9.

messages_per_min.description:
Posts per minute across the App's Spaces (posts, replies, forwards and scheduled sends
when they fire), 1–1e6: a token bucket of this size that refills over a minute.

changed.description: `POST` only: whether this call changed the quotas (`false` on a repeat).

quotas.description: The quotas set (absent: no App limit).

used.description: The current usage against each quota.
